description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories analyzed in the paper, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and labeled with its percentage share. The chart contains twelve distinct slices, each with a unique color and labeled with both the category name and its approximate percentage. The largest segment is "People Blogs" at 17.2%, followed by "Howto Style" at 9.7% and "Education" at 8.7%. Other notable segments include "Entertainment" at 13.9%, "Sports" at 6.4%, and "Comedy" at 5.6%. Smaller segments include "Music" at 2.3%, "Autos Vehicles" at 4.8%, "Pets Animals" at 3.9%, and "News Politics" at 4.3%. The chart includes percentage labels directly within each slice and a clear legend connecting each color to its category name. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top-right.
